profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Crestron Electronics
profile.summary:
I am a full stack developer (strong focus on Frontend Development as well as UX/UI development) with a diverse set of skills that allows me to efficiently work both client side and server side. Dedicated and driven to create clean and simple code. 

My current skills sets range from HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap3, Boostrap4, Materialize, Material Design Angular, Zurb Foundation , CSS Flexbox, JavaScript, Responsive Design, jQuery, API/JSON, Node.js, Express, Angular.js, Angular4, Lodash, RESTful API, Firebase, MySQL, Ajax, State Management, Active Record, Command Line, creation of Content Management Systems (CMS), Git, Trello, Wrike, Teamwork, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Teams and Visual Studio.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Work on complete life cycle of projects. Help with requirement gathering, developing wire frame and application. Perform unit testing as well as technical support after go live. 

●	PowerBI Developer/Administrator – Created numerous PowerBI reports which were connected to our backend database to provide real time metric reporting. Reports were custom built based on businesses requirements and needs. 

●	Quotes Web Application Lead Developer – Developed wireframe for the application and helped develop the final application. Worked on both front-end and backend of the application. Gave weekly demos to the business to ensure that application was on the right track. Daily scrum meetings with our team in India. – HTML5, CSS3, Angular 4, Bootstrap 3, PrimeNG, TypeScript, C#, SQL.

●	CDTL Web Application – Fix front-end related issues as well as bug fixes. Assisted lead developer with UX/UI related issues and concerns. – HTML5, CSS3, Angular 4, Bootstrap3, PrimeNG, TypeScript, C#, SQL.

●	CDTS Web Application – Completed front-end tasks assigned to me. Helped create responsive design and media queries throughout application. Daily technical support of application. – HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 3, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL.

●	Intranet – Lead developer – Redesign and develop new Intranet site. Assisted with requirement gathering, development of Intranet as well as unit testing and technical support. – HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 3, JavaScript, jQuery, DNN8, SQL.

●	Intern Mentor Program 2017 – Participated in mentorship program and mentored an individual who was interested in becoming a web developer. Provided knowledge transfer as well as small tasks to help build confidence in web development. Gave knowledge transfer in front-end development. - HTML, CSS, jQuery, JavaScript and bootstrap Framework.

positions.title: Rutgers Coding Bootcamp
positions.description:
Rutgers Coding Bootcamp’s Full-Stack Flex Program

An intensive 24-week long bootcamp dedicated to designing and building web applications

Skills Developed:

HTML5 | CSS3 | Bootstrap | JavaScript | jQuery | Command Line | Git | GitHub | Responsive Design | API/JSON | RESTful API | Node.js | Express | Angular.js | Lodash | Firebase | MySQL | Ajax | State Management | MySQL | Active Record

Topics Covered:

Database Theory | API's | Agile Methodologies | Presentation Skills | Research Methods | System Administration | Quality Assurance Testing | Social Coding Best Practices | Computer Science

positions.title: Relationship Manager
positions.description:
•	Acts as main point of contact for outside sales offices, responsible for training and assisting  with sales strategy and development of their sales organization 
•	Recruit & Train new sales offices and ISO
•	Create and execute new sales strategies to increase overall sales and profit for the company.
•	Lead, motivate, and counsel ISOs to exceed expected sales while maintaining the highest level of customer service
•	Analyze sales data and find solutions to increase sales
•	Handle highly confidential information in a professional manner
•	Communicate by phone and email to provide solutions to the sales office’s issues.
•	Submit weekly and monthly reports to supervisors regarding sales ideas, promotional incentives, agent suggestions, and merchant accounts overview 
•	Work with MS Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel on advanced levels

positions.title: Technical Support Team Member / Service Request Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Troubleshooter for credit card terminals and Point of Sales (POS) systems. Ensured quick solutions and technical support to merchants. 
•	Supervised and conducted multiple special projects given (Mobile pay, e-commerce, Payment card industry self-assessment questionnaires) 
•	Retained merchant accounts through professionalism and hospitality

positions.title: Coding Specialist
positions.description:
•	Promoted to Coding Specialist in a fast-paced influential merchant services company.
•	Built approximately 30-40 files on a daily basis through a complex internal program that is linked to billing and private merchant information
•	Completed daily tasks of building coding files in a timely and efficient manner
•	Cross checked all built files to ensure the minimization of error
•	Generated and updated periodically user manuals for merchants and sales partners
•	Created monthly reports for upper managements
•	Worked with MS Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel on advanced levels

positions.title: E-biz Representative
positions.description:
•	Supervised the full process of E-commerce businesses from customer pick up to the final delivery of products and goods.
•	Met with prospective clients to obtain contracts 
•	Implemented business plans and strategies to set up a new warehouse for 3 e-commerce businesses
•	Aided in hiring process of new potential employees
•	Utilized superior customer service skills to ensure clientele satisfaction
